items.title: Feed action row: reactions then comment icon
items.precondition: Signed in; Feed shows at least one post with ReactionBar
steps: Under a post body, confirm ReactionBar and a comment icon sit in one horizontal row (icon to the right of the reaction control)
Confirm there is no visible “Comment” text label on that control
Confirm no comment count is shown on the icon
items.expected: Mock-matching action row: reaction control then comment icon only.
items.evidence: Human review 2026-07-29 on localhost:5181 — action row matches mock; MessageSquare icon beside reactions.

items.title: Feed comment icon opens post comments; body no longer navigates
items.precondition: Signed in on Feed with at least one post
steps: Click the post body text — confirm it does not navigate to post detail
Click the comment icon beside reactions
Confirm URL is /posts/:id#comments (or lands on detail with comments in view)
items.expected: Only the comment icon enters detail/comments; body click is inert for navigation.
items.evidence: Human review 2026-07-29 — body no longer navigates; comment icon opens detail comments.

items.title: Post detail comment icon scrolls to comments
items.precondition: Signed in on a post detail page
steps: Confirm post ReactionBar has a comment icon beside it
Confirm the comments section (id=comments) scrolls into view
items.expected: Detail comment icon focuses/scrolls to the comments block without leaving the page.
items.evidence: Human review 2026-07-29 — detail comment icon scrolls to comments section.

items.title: Reply icon beside comment reactions
items.precondition: Signed in on a post with at least one top-level comment
steps: Under a parent comment, confirm ReactionBar and a reply icon sit in one row
Confirm there is no text “Reply” button as the reply trigger
Confirm the inline reply composer opens (same as before)
Submit a reply and confirm it nests under the parent
items.expected: Reply is icon-triggered beside reactions; one-level reply flow unchanged.
items.evidence: Human review 2026-07-29 — reply icon beside reactions; flow confirmed OK.

items.title: Compose submit labels stay text
steps: Confirm the top-level compose submit button still says “Comment”
Open a reply form and confirm its submit button still says “Reply”
items.expected: Only row affordances are icons; form submits keep text labels.
items.evidence: Human review 2026-07-29 — compose submit labels remain text.

items.title: No backend / dependency changes; typecheck green
steps: Diff confirms no database/migrations or API route changes for this feature
items.evidence: Diff limited to FeedPage, PostDetailPage, PostActionRow (+ plan artifacts). npm run typecheck / lint / build green after npm install in exec worktree.
